rules.statement: A cause of action in a case like the present does not arise until the person in the Appu position of the defendant definitely declines to do what is requested of him, when so requested, or, until it comes to the knowledge of the plaintiff that the defendant has taken a definite step which can only indicate that he regards himself as the absolute owner.
rules.supporting_quote: The appeal is dismissed with costs. DRIEBERG J.-I agree. Appeal dismissed. As regards the question of prescription, I think that a cause of action in a case like the present does not arise until the person in the Appu position of the defendant definitely declines to do what is requested of him, when so requested, or, until it comes to the knowledge of the plaintiff that the defendant has taken a definite step which can only indicate that he regards himself as the absolute owner.
